title: Tile surface: glaze + grout
description: White glazed tile, subtle light variation, light grey grout with slight texture.

title: Wallpaper: cream embossed vintage floral
description: Tiling repeat pattern, embossed via lighting. Constants: WALLPAPER_ZOOM, HEADER_HEIGHT.

title: Project scaffold
description: git, bd, Vite+TS strict, vite-plugin-singlefile, Vitest, Playwright (chromium/firefox/webkit + iPhone/Pixel), src/config.ts → CSS vars, CLAUDE.md, skeletal README, projects.json + public/logos/.
close_reason: Done; unit + e2e green across 6 browser projects

title: Layout maths (pure fn + tests)
description: Tile size T = min(TILE_MAX, (W-2G)/1.5, (Hsvh-2G)/1.5). N full columns: grout counted once per joint; add a column only if a full tile + grout fits while keeping >=0.25T visible each side. Edge partials always blank. Tiles square.
close_reason: Done; unit + e2e green across 6 browser projects

title: Cross-browser matrix + visual baselines
description: Playwright projects for chromium/firefox/webkit desktop + mobile emulation; screenshot baselines. Manual real-iOS-Safari check periodically (webkit ≠ iOS Safari).

title: About page
description: Undecided. Proposal (not committed): about text hand-written on the back of the embroidery; click flips the frame to reveal it like a personal note. Must live inside the single HTML.

title: Skirting board: paint, grain, dust
description: White gloss paint with visible thick brush strokes, subtle timber grain beneath, faint dust on top edge — lived-in, not dirty.

title: Review: above-the-fold balance + frame tilt
description: Desktop 1440x900: header 1T + bull-nose 0.5T pushes first project row to ~y=600, so only its top half shows above the fold. FRAME_TILT_DEG=10 reads as visibly crooked; 2–4° may read as 'slightly askew'. Nic to judge via panel.

title: Projects from projects.json
description: Ordered list in src/projects.json: {title, url, logo} with logo filename in src/logos/. Test validates fields and logo existence. Tiles link to url.
close_reason: projects.json + src/logos/ loader, validation test, tiles link out

title: Hover effects
description: Iterate independently once layout is done. Ideas: slow cracking, shimmer, 3D, limescale build-up. Needs touch equivalent on mobile.

title: Bull-nose detail
description: Rounded-edge glaze highlight matching tile white.

title: Dev tweak panel with save-to-config
description: Dev-only lil-gui panel bound to every constant in src/config.ts; live update. 'Save' button POSTs values to a Vite dev-server endpoint that rewrites src/config.ts. Must be tree-shaken from build.
close_reason: Done; unit + e2e green across 6 browser projects

title: Flat structure pass
description: Header (HEADER_HEIGHT), bull-nose row (½T × 1.6T, BULLNOSE_OFFSET arbitrary joint position), tile grid centred, last row filled with blanks when N>1, TRAILING_ROWS blank rows, skirting board; page ends at skirting. Flat colours only — geometry check across devices.
close_reason: Flat pass done; awaiting Nic's geometry review

title: Halftone print renderer (in-browser canvas)
description: Committed approach: per tile, draw title (webfont) + logo to offscreen canvas, sample luminance on rotated grid, draw variable-radius dots in hazy blue. Dot pitch fixed in CSS px, DPR-aware, re-render on resize. Real text stays in DOM for a11y. Iterate on ink bleed, misregistration, glaze haze — expect many rounds.

title: Cross-stitch embroidery frame
description: Framed cross-stitch 'Snickers McNoose', blue and white, teal + peach florals top-left and bottom-right. Centred on wallpaper, rotated FRAME_TILT_DEG clockwise (start 10).
